description: Discover a peaceful retreat at Baker Farms, a beautiful new home community in Cleburne, Texas, where small-town charm meets modern living. Located just minutes from Highway 67 and the Chisholm Trail Parkway, residents enjoy effortless access to major employers, shopping and dining throughout the DFW metro, all while savoring the quiet pace of suburban life.

Nearby parks, lakes and local attractions also make it easy to explore the outdoors while staying close to home. Baker Farms offers a peaceful neighborhood setting without sacrificing proximity to the places you love. Experience the best of both worlds with our team at Sandlin Homes, one of the most trusted home builders in Cleburne.
